editor_note: Both rewritten entries are faithful. Entry 10 keeps every point of the English, including the conditional "a seconda che la primitiva modifichi o meno questa impostazione" and the contrast between big-endian Sampler/Estimator and little-endian Executor ("mentre Executor restituisce risultati little-endian"), and the heading "Primitive" is the correct Italian plural.

The rewritten headings (entries 1, 2, 5, 6, 13, 15, 34) turn the English labels into second-person imperatives: "Monitora", "Calibra", "Esegui il benchmark", "Monitora in modo olistico". These sections describe processes that IBM runs on its own machines, not steps the reader carries out. Entry 4 even introduces them as nouns ("monitoraggio, calibrazione e benchmarking"). An Italian technical editor would use noun headings here ("Monitoraggio, calibrazione e benchmarking", "Monitoraggio dei parametri", "Monitoraggio olistico", "Calibrazione", "Benchmarking"), which would also match the neighbouring descriptive headings. The meaning is not distorted, so this stays minor.

examples.source: Monitor, calibrate, and benchmark
examples.translation: Monitora, calibra ed esegui il benchmark
examples.suggested: Monitoraggio, calibrazione e benchmarking
examples.why: This page title names three IBM-side processes, and entry 4 calls them by these nouns. The imperative suggests these are tasks for the reader.

examples.source: Benchmark
examples.translation: Esegui il benchmark
examples.suggested: Benchmarking
examples.why: The section describes IBM's daily benchmarking, not something the user runs. A noun heading is the natural Italian choice and matches entry 35.

examples.source: Monitor holistically
examples.translation: Monitora in modo olistico
examples.suggested: Monitoraggio olistico
examples.why: A noun phrase is more idiomatic for a heading and matches the sibling headings such as 'Operazioni a singolo qubit'.

editor_note: The 7 rewritten entries are faithful and read naturally: "modello di esecuzione guidata", "caratterizzazione del rumore quantistico basata sulla randomizzazione", "ZNE basato su gate-folding, oltre alla postselezione per filtrare gli errori non markoviani" and "codifiche da fermioni a qubit" all keep the source meaning, and they use the informal tu throughout (Puoi, Scopri, Consulta).

Entries 5–10 match the English in meaning: XY-mixer instead of penalty terms, SWAP-free non-local interactions and the enable/disable/compare options are all kept. The new entries leave "transpilation" in English (entries 7, 8, 9), while the older entry 69 on the same page uses the Italian "transpilazione". In entry 7, "raw circuit" and "original circuit logic" both become "originale", which repeats the word and loses the sense of an unprocessed baseline. Entry 8's "Ciò consente dimensioni di problemi di ottimizzazione..." reads as a calque of the English.

examples.source: combines optimized transpilation, dynamical decoupling
examples.translation: combina transpilation ottimizzata, dynamical decoupling
examples.suggested: combina transpilazione ottimizzata, dynamical decoupling
examples.why: Entry 69 on the same page uses 'transpilazione'. Entries 7, 8 and 9 keep the English 'transpilation', so the page uses two forms of one term.

examples.source: compare each technique against the raw circuit
examples.translation: confrontare ciascuna tecnica rispetto al circuito originale
examples.suggested: confrontare ciascuna tecnica con il circuito non ottimizzato
examples.why: The previous clause already uses 'originale' for 'original circuit logic'. Using it again blurs the idea of an unprocessed baseline, and 'confrontare ... rispetto a' is stiff.

examples.source: This enables industry-relevant optimization problem sizes that are unfeasible with standard, SWAP-heavy transpilation methods.
examples.translation: Ciò consente dimensioni di problemi di ottimizzazione rilevanti per l'industria che non sono realizzabili con i metodi di transpilation standard, ricchi di SWAP.
examples.suggested: Ciò permette di affrontare problemi di ottimizzazione di dimensioni rilevanti per l'industria, non gestibili con i metodi di transpilazione standard che fanno largo uso di SWAP.
examples.why: 'consente dimensioni di problemi' copies the English word order, and 'ricchi di SWAP' is an awkward rendering of 'SWAP-heavy'.

editor_note: Entry 5 is faithful and nothing in it misleads: Sampler/Estimator "lato client", "primitive V1" and the skill name are all correct, and it uses informal "tu". Two small edits: "skill per agenti ufficiali, verificate da IBM" reads as if the agents are official, when the English says the skills are; reorder to "skill ufficiali per agenti, verificate da IBM". Also, "In futuro" drops "near" from "in the near future"; use "A breve" or "Nel prossimo futuro".

examples.source: contains official, IBM-verified agent skills
examples.translation: contiene skill per agenti ufficiali, verificate da IBM
examples.suggested: contiene skill ufficiali per agenti, verificate da IBM
examples.why: As written, "ufficiali" attaches to "agenti". In the English, "official" describes the skills.

examples.source: We will be adding more skills to this repository in the near future.
examples.translation: In futuro aggiungeremo altre skill a questo repository.
examples.suggested: A breve aggiungeremo altre skill a questo repository.
examples.why: Dropping "near" softens the timeframe. It's a small loss and won't mislead anyone.

editor_note: Entry 129 is accurate and keeps every point of the English: client-side intent capture, variant generation moved to the server, Samplomatic layers for Pauli-twirling and noise injection, and Executor generating and running the randomized variants in Qiskit Runtime. Nothing in it would mislead a learner. Two small naturalness slips remain. "acquisire le intenzioni di progettazione" is a stiff calque of "capture design intents", and "catturare/esprimere gli intenti di progettazione" reads more naturally. "ottimizzare" also loses the "fine" in "fine-tune", where "regolare con precisione" keeps it. The new heading "Modello di esecuzione guidata" is a reasonable rendering, but entry 20 keeps the English link text "Directed execution model (beta)", so the page now names the feature two ways.

examples.source: by providing the ingredients to capture design intents on the client side
examples.translation: fornendo gli ingredienti per acquisire le intenzioni di progettazione lato client
examples.suggested: fornendo gli strumenti per esprimere gli intenti di progettazione lato client
examples.why: 'acquisire le intenzioni' is a literal calque that sounds odd to an Italian reader. In this context 'intenti di progettazione' with 'esprimere' or 'catturare' is the idiomatic choice.

examples.source: allows you to fine-tune error mitigation and other techniques
examples.translation: ti consente di ottimizzare la mitigazione degli errori e altre tecniche
examples.suggested: ti consente di regolare con precisione la mitigazione degli errori e altre tecniche
examples.why: 'ottimizzare' drops the idea of fine-grained control that 'fine-tune' carries, which is the main point of the directed model. The meaning is close but a little flattened.

editor_note: The 10 rewritten entries say the same thing as the English and read naturally in Italian. 'Directed execution model' is rendered consistently as 'modello di esecuzione guidata', and 'low-friction' becomes 'progettato per richiedere il minimo sforzo', which reads well. The informal 'tu' register holds throughout ('devi solo modificare', 'Consulta').

The translation is faithful and nothing in it would mislead a learner. The conditional/unconditional reset footnote [12], the DC/AC TLS bias descriptions and the calibration table all match the source exactly. Two small fixes are worth making. In [18], "i job dei primitive" is awkward because it puts a masculine Italian article in front of an English plural, and Italian Qiskit prose normally says "le primitive". In [21], "might improve" became "possono migliorare", which states the benefit a little more firmly than the hedged English.

examples.source: primitive jobs that you run on the backend execute with it
examples.translation: i job dei primitive che esegui sul backend vengono eseguiti con essa
examples.suggested: i job delle primitive che esegui sul backend usano questa calibrazione
examples.why: "dei primitive" mixes an Italian masculine article with an English plural. The usual Italian form is the feminine "le primitive", and "vengono eseguiti con essa" sounds stiff.

examples.source: Slower `cz` gates might improve performance
examples.translation: I gate `cz` più lenti possono migliorare le prestazioni
examples.suggested: I gate `cz` più lenti potrebbero migliorare le prestazioni
examples.why: The conditional "potrebbero" keeps the English hedge "might". "Possono" makes the benefit sound a little more certain than the source does.

editor_note: Entry 24 keeps the English meaning and links intact: guides, API reference ("riferimento API"), and feedback and bug reports to the GitHub repository. Nothing in it would mislead a learner. One naturalness slip: "Sentiti libero di inviare feedback" copies the English "Feel free to" word for word, and an Italian technical writer would more likely write "Non esitare a inviare feedback" or simply "Puoi inviare feedback". The informal "tu" register is kept ("consulta", "Sentiti").

examples.source: Feel free to submit feedback and report bugs in its [GitHub](https://github.com/Qiskit/samplomatic) repository.
examples.translation: Sentiti libero di inviare feedback e segnalare bug nel suo repository [GitHub](https://github.com/Qiskit/samplomatic).
examples.suggested: Non esitare a inviare feedback e a segnalare bug nel suo repository [GitHub](https://github.com/Qiskit/samplomatic).
examples.why: "Sentiti libero di" copies the English "Feel free to" word for word and reads as translated text. "Non esitare a" or "Puoi" is the idiomatic Italian way to invite the reader.

editor_note: None of the 10 rewritten entries misleads. The how-to-enable lists (11, 19, 25, 35, 42, 52) keep every option, condition and the PEA-requires-ZNE caveat. Entry 11 leaves "dynamical decoupling" in English twice ("Puoi abilitare il dynamical decoupling", "passo del transpiler per il dynamical decoupling"), but the rest of the page uses "disaccoppiamento dinamico" (heading [6] and the body in [7]–[9]), so the term is inconsistent within the file. In entry 4, "modello di esecuzione diretta" reads as "direct execution" rather than "directed". It still works as a feature name, but it is a slightly imprecise rendering.

examples.source: You can enable dynamical decoupling the following ways: ... The [Dynamical decoupling transpiler pass] ... The dynamical decoupling option
examples.translation: Puoi abilitare il dynamical decoupling nei seguenti modi: ... [passo del transpiler per il dynamical decoupling] ... L'opzione di dynamical decoupling
examples.suggested: Puoi abilitare il disaccoppiamento dinamico nei seguenti modi: ... [passo del transpiler per il disaccoppiamento dinamico] ... L'opzione di disaccoppiamento dinamico
examples.why: The heading [6] and the body [7]-[9] use 'disaccoppiamento dinamico', so this entry is inconsistent with the rest of the file.

examples.source: The directed execution model provides more flexibility
examples.translation: Il modello di esecuzione diretta offre maggiore flessibilità
examples.suggested: Il modello di esecuzione guidata (directed execution model) offre maggiore flessibilità
examples.why: 'Diretta' reads as 'direct' rather than 'directed'. It is defensible but slightly imprecise for a named feature.

editor_note: The 21 rewritten entries are faithful and read naturally: "Come abilitarlo" / "Opzioni rilevanti" / "Riferimento API" are used the same way throughout, the PEA caveat keeps its meaning in "(devi abilitare anche ZNE)", and entry 49 keeps the v0.50.0 client-side caveat that PEA and PEC need a separate noise-learning job ("è necessario un job separato di apprendimento del rumore").

Entry 43 matches the English and uses the informal "tu" register ("visita il [riferimento API di `qiskit-ibm-runtime`] e seleziona una versione precedente"); "versioni di opzioni precedenti" mirrors the English wording closely but is clear and acceptable.

Entry 54 matches the English item for item: "directed execution model" becomes "modello di esecuzione guidata" in both places it appears, "opzioni di Executor" keeps the primitive name in English, and the PEC tutorial title stays in English, with informal "Consulta/Scopri/Comprendi" throughout.

The four rewritten entries (32, 34, 35, 36) keep the meaning: the little-endian axis, "indice 0 … il bit meno significativo", the shapes (28, 10, 1024, 3) and (28, 10, 1, 3), and the reason given for the single shot all match the English. The one thing to change is in entry 34, which renders "task" as the English "task" ("secondo task"). Everywhere else on the page it is "compito" (entries 13, 16, 21, 24 and the parallel entry 30, "primo compito"), so entry 34 should use "compito" too.

examples.source: The second item contains the results of running the second task (a `SamplexItem`) in the program.
examples.translation: Il secondo elemento contiene i risultati dell'esecuzione del secondo task (un `SamplexItem`) nel programma.
examples.suggested: Il secondo elemento contiene i risultati dell'esecuzione del secondo compito (un `SamplexItem`) nel programma.
examples.why: The rest of the page renders 'task' as 'compito', including the parallel sentence in entry 30 ('primo compito'). Using 'task' here makes the two parallel sentences inconsistent.

editor_note: Entry 11 is faithful and natural. "Executor può elaborare solo informazioni codificate in samplex" keeps the "only" restriction, and "samplex" stays invariant as it does in entry 6. "Consulta le guide di Samplomatic per comprendere le restrizioni" uses the informal "tu" register.

Neither rewritten entry (12 and 15) changes the meaning. The caveats, quantities and comparisons all survive, for example "1 kcal/mol, 1,6 mHa", "40-60 qubit", "rispettivamente, di ordini di grandezza" and "senza addestramento di parametri variazionali". There is one term inconsistency: both entries use the English "transpilation" (Orbit, Parity Twine, Constrained Optimizer), but entry 7 on the same page uses "transpilazione". Entry 12 also says "workflow unificato" while the rest of the page says "flusso di lavoro". A few calques in entry 15 read stiffly: "consente input di definizioni di problema ad alto livello" and "risultando in maggiore efficienza".

examples.source: Combines optimized transpilation, dynamical decoupling, and measurement error mitigation into a unified workflow
examples.translation: Combina transpilation ottimizzata, dynamical decoupling e mitigazione degli errori di misura in un workflow unificato
examples.suggested: Combina transpilazione ottimizzata, dynamical decoupling e mitigazione degli errori di misura in un flusso di lavoro unificato
examples.why: Entry 7 uses "transpilazione" and the page otherwise says "flusso di lavoro". The two rewritten entries switch to English for both words.

examples.source: enables inputs of high-level problem definitions
examples.translation: che consente input di definizioni di problema ad alto livello
examples.suggested: che accetta in input definizioni di problema ad alto livello
examples.why: This is a word-for-word calque, and "consente input di" is not idiomatic Italian.

examples.source: resulting in greater efficiency, reduced model complexity, and more robust performance
examples.translation: risultando in maggiore efficienza, minore complessità del modello e prestazioni più robuste
examples.suggested: ottenendo così maggiore efficienza, minore complessità del modello e prestazioni più robuste
examples.why: "Risultando in" copies the English "resulting in". A native technical writer would use "ottenendo" or "con conseguente".

editor_note: Entries 25 and 27 are faithful and read naturally: "circuito template" matches entries 24 and 26, "gate a singolo qubit vengono sostituiti da gate parametrizzati" and "twirling di gate e misurazioni" keep the meaning exactly, and the "tu" register holds ("usa", "Consulta").

All 17 rewritten DR entries match the English and read naturally. Conditions and caveats are intact: "Potresti non essere in grado di cambiare regione se, ad esempio" and "Se cambiare regione non è un'opzione, attendi che IBM ripristini il servizio" keep the original meaning. Terms are consistent ("guasto regionale", "invia di nuovo i job interessati", "effettua il provisioning"), and the informal tu register holds.

All 13 rewritten entries say what the English says. The legacy vs client-side primitives contrast (entries 24 and 41), the v0.50.0 version claims, the 32-qubit caveat and the overhead caveat are all carried over intact, so nothing would mislead a learner. There are two small polish points. "before committing QPU time" is rendered as the calque "prima di impegnare tempo QPU" in entries 23 and 40, where "prima di spendere/usare tempo QPU" would read more naturally. Entry 45 says "simulazione di Clifford", while the rest of the page uses "simulazione Clifford" (entries 11, 35, 36).

examples.source: so you can experiment with different error mitigation methods on a fake backend before committing QPU time.
examples.translation: quindi puoi sperimentare con diversi metodi di mitigazione degli errori su un fake backend prima di impegnare tempo QPU.
examples.suggested: quindi puoi sperimentare diversi metodi di mitigazione degli errori su un fake backend prima di spendere tempo QPU.
examples.why: 'impegnare tempo QPU' is a literal calque of 'committing QPU time'. The same phrase also appears in entry 23.

examples.source: - [Clifford simulation](#clifford-sim), which scales to a large number of qubits.
examples.translation: - La [simulazione di Clifford](#clifford-sim), che scala a un numero elevato di qubit.
examples.suggested: - La [simulazione Clifford](#clifford-sim), che scala a un numero elevato di qubit.
examples.why: Entries 11, 35 and 36 use 'simulazione Clifford', so this entry should match them.

editor_note: Entry 64 is faithful and reads naturally. It keeps the "dopo aver tenuto conto delle correzioni ... che annullano il twirling delle misurazioni" caveat, and its terms match the rest of the page: "valori di aspettazione" as in entry 13 and "twirling delle misurazioni" as in entry 93.

Both rewritten entries are faithful and read naturally. Entry 21 renders "consider using" as "valuta di usare", and entry 27 renders "you can pass the `twirling_strategy` option" as "puoi passare l'opzione"; both say "box annotati", as entries 17 and 19 already do.

Both rewritten entries say the same thing as the English and would not mislead a learner. Entry 65 reads naturally ("un oggetto che contiene tutte le informazioni necessarie per transpilare un circuito", "gate `cz` che agisce tra una coppia di qubit connessi"). The one problem is in entry 46, the table of supported instructions: three row labels start lowercase ("gate a singolo qubit", "gate a due qubit", "gate frazionari"), while the other rows are capitalized ("Istruzioni non unitarie", "Flusso di controllo") and so is the header "Categoria di operazione". It looks like a mechanical artifact of keeping "gate" in English. A native editor would capitalize the first word of each label.

examples.source: | Single-qubit gates | ... | Two-qubit gates | ... | Fractional gates | ...
examples.translation: | gate a singolo qubit | ... | gate a due qubit | ... | gate frazionari | ...
examples.suggested: | Gate a singolo qubit | ... | Gate a due qubit | ... | Gate frazionari | ...
examples.why: Table category labels start lowercase, unlike the other rows ('Istruzioni non unitarie', 'Flusso di controllo') and the header. Italian table cells normally start with a capital letter.

editor_note: Entry 18 is faithful and reads naturally: "strumenti lato client/lato server", "distribuire il calcolo e gestire i dati" and "`python` 3.11 o versione successiva" match the English, and it keeps the informal register ("Consulta", "segui").

Entry 26 says the same thing as the English: all six linked resources are there, and nothing is added or dropped. Two small wording slips remain. "gli accordi di licenza PDF per i contributori individuali" copies the English noun stacking, and an Italian writer would put "accordi di licenza in PDF per singoli contributori". The comma before "e le guide" copies the English serial comma, which Italian does not normally use.

examples.source: PDF license agreements for individual and corporate contributors
examples.translation: gli accordi di licenza PDF per i contributori individuali e aziendali
examples.suggested: gli accordi di licenza in PDF per singoli contributori e per aziende
examples.why: "accordi di licenza PDF" and "contributori individuali" copy the English word order. "in PDF" and "singoli contributori" are the usual Italian forms.

examples.source: [version strategy], and the [contributor] and [maintainer] guides
examples.translation: la [strategia di versioning], e le guide per i [contributori] e i [maintainer]
examples.suggested: la [strategia di versioning] e le guide per i [contributori] e i [maintainer]
examples.why: Italian does not normally put a comma before the last "e" in a list. This one comes from the English.

editor_note: All six rewritten entries keep the English meaning. Entries 13 and 17 keep the claim that no account is needed and keep the caveat that hardware or cloud pages say so when you run them. Entries 5, 6, 13 and 17 use informal "tu" throughout. The one thing a native editor would change is in entry 14: the card titles copy English title case ("Hello World: Il Tuo Primo Circuito Quantistico", "Fondamenti dell'Informazione Quantistica"). Italian titles capitalise only the first word, so these should be sentence case. The other card titles in the same block already are ("Costruire circuiti", "Algoritmo di Grover").

examples.source: Hello World: Your First Quantum Circuit
examples.translation: Hello World: Il Tuo Primo Circuito Quantistico
examples.suggested: Hello World: il tuo primo circuito quantistico
examples.why: English title case copied into Italian, which capitalises only the first word of a title. The other cards in this block ('Costruire circuiti') are already sentence case.

examples.source: Basics of Quantum Information
examples.translation: Fondamenti dell'Informazione Quantistica
examples.suggested: Fondamenti dell'informazione quantistica
examples.why: Same title-case calque. Leave it only if the Italian course title is capitalised this way everywhere else on the site.

editor_note: Entry 42 is faithful and natural, with every claim intact: "operatori fermionici (di creazione e distruzione)", "antisimmetria sotto scambio", the need for "un operatore bosonico" on QPU IBM Quantum, Pauli operators as "sia hermitiani che unitari", and "trasformazione Jordan-Wigner". Its terms match entries 16, 45 and 47.

The meaning is faithful throughout, including the caveats in Sections 2.5 and the wrap-up, but terminology splits partway through the page. 'Check' is 'controllo' up to Section 2.3 and then English 'check' from 2.4 on. 'Gate' moves from 'gate' to 'porte', 'layer' alternates with 'strati', 'postselezione' with 'post-selezione', 'codici spaziotemporali' with 'codici spacetime' in [306]/[308]/[314], and 'wire' with 'filo'/'linea'. Entry [142] slightly misstates the closing caveat: 'il rapporto qui sopra non lo mostra' says the ratio does not show the noise, when the English says the ratio does not carry over to larger payloads. Entry [89] has a broken LaTeX exponent with a stray parenthesis.

examples.source: The conclusion that the syndrome-extraction circuit is itself noisy still holds, even though the ratio above does not.
examples.translation: La conclusione che il circuito di estrazione della sindrome è esso stesso rumoroso resta valida, anche se il rapporto qui sopra non lo mostra.
examples.suggested: …resta valida, anche se il rapporto qui sopra non si generalizza.
examples.why: The English says the overhead ratio does not hold for larger payloads. The Italian says the ratio fails to show the noise, which is a different claim.

examples.source: (-1)^{\text{number of }1\text{s}}
examples.translation: (-1)^{\text{numero di }1\text{ })}
examples.suggested: (-1)^{\text{numero di }1}
examples.why: The exponent has a stray ')' that will show up in the rendered formula.

examples.source: …the added check cost… Paulice checks… ten CZ layers
examples.translation: …il costo aggiuntivo dei check… i check Paulice… dieci layer CZ
examples.suggested: controlli / strati, as in Sections 1–2.3
examples.why: Sections 1 to 2.3 use 'controllo', 'strati' and 'porte'. From 2.4 on the page switches to 'check' and 'layer', so the same concept has two names in one lesson.

examples.source: spacetime codes here use syndrome information
examples.translation: i codici spacetime qui usano le informazioni di sindrome
examples.suggested: i codici spaziotemporali
examples.why: The rest of the page says 'codici spaziotemporali'. The same switch appears in the headings [308] and [314].

examples.source: we detect them and discard the runs they touched
examples.translation: li rileviamo e scartiamo le esecuzioni che hanno interessato
examples.suggested: li rileviamo e scartiamo le esecuzioni in cui si sono verificati
examples.why: The relative clause is ambiguous: it can be read as the runs having affected something, not the errors affecting the runs.

examples.source: post-selected quantum error correction
examples.translation: correzione quantistica degli errori con postselezione
examples.suggested: pick one spelling: post-selezione (used from §1.1 on)
examples.why: The intro uses 'postselezione' and the body uses 'post-selezione'. 'post-elaborazione' and 'post-processing' also alternate for the same term.

editor_note: The meaning is faithful all the way through, including the long PEC derivation, the TREX exercise and the compatibility caveats, and I found nothing that would mislead a learner. The polish problems are consistency ones. "Transpile" appears as "transpiliamo"/"transpilazione" ([48], [31]), as "traspila"/"traspilazione" ([124], [125], [164]) and as "Eseguiamo il transpile" ([427]). PEC is feminine in most places ("la PEC") but masculine in [253], [270], [275] and [318], and the text switches between "workflow" and "flusso di lavoro". There are also a few slips: [165] says "preferibile rispetto alle assunzioni" (preferable compared to the assumptions) where it should be "in vista delle" (given the assumptions), [87] uses "errori di riporto" (arithmetic carry) for "reporting errors", [278] switches to "Ho scelto" (I chose) where the English says "we", and [438] uses the awkward "uso molto scarso".

examples.source: Often local folding is preferable for assumptions made by ZNE, but both are possible.
examples.translation: Spesso il folding locale è preferibile rispetto alle assunzioni fatte da ZNE, ma entrambi sono possibili.
examples.suggested: Spesso il folding locale è preferibile in vista delle assunzioni fatte da ZNE, ma entrambi sono possibili.
examples.why: 'rispetto a' means 'compared to', so the sentence wrongly compares folding with assumptions. The English means local folding fits ZNE's assumptions better.

examples.source: We transpile our circuit and apply the resulting layout to our observables.
examples.translation: Eseguiamo il transpile del nostro circuito e applichiamo il layout risultante alle nostre osservabili.
examples.suggested: Traspiliamo il nostro circuito e applichiamo il layout risultante alle nostre osservabili.
examples.why: There are three renderings of transpile in this file (transpiliamo/transpilazione in [48]/[31], traspila/traspilazione in [124]/[125]/[187], 'eseguiamo il transpile' here). Pick one.

examples.source: PEC is complex and it is not recommended that you implement it by hand.
examples.translation: PEC è complesso e non è consigliabile implementarlo a mano.
examples.suggested: La PEC è complessa e non è consigliabile implementarla a mano.
examples.why: PEC is feminine ('la PEC') elsewhere in the file but masculine here and in [253], [270] and [318].

examples.source: The asymmetry between these reporting errors introduces a measurement bias.
examples.translation: L'asimmetria tra questi errori di riporto introduce un bias di misura.
examples.suggested: L'asimmetria tra questi errori di registrazione dell'esito introduce un bias di misura.
examples.why: 'Riporto' suggests an arithmetic carry, which is the wrong idea here. The source means the outcome being reported wrongly.

examples.source: We've chosen this density matrix because it is not diagonal...
examples.translation: Ho scelto questa matrice densità perché non è diagonale...
examples.suggested: Abbiamo scelto questa matrice densità perché non è diagonale...
examples.why: This switches to first-person singular, while the rest of the lesson uses 'we' (noi).

examples.source: This is a very poor use for a research application of quantum computing, but an excellent one for benchmarking
examples.translation: Questo è un uso molto scarso per un'applicazione di ricerca del calcolo quantistico, ma ottimo per fare benchmark
examples.suggested: Come applicazione di ricerca del calcolo quantistico è una scelta pessima, ma è ottima per fare benchmark
examples.why: 'Uso molto scarso' is a calque. In Italian, 'scarso' means scant, not poor in quality.

editor_note: Delta entries 6 and 7 are faithful and natural, with "soppressione degli errori" used the same way as in the rest of the page, and the video title translated in full ("tecniche di soppressione degli errori quantistici, di come funzionano e di come si collegano ad altri metodi").

All four rewritten titles are faithful and idiomatic, with correct sentence case: "Chimica quantistica con VQE", "Usa un computer quantistico oggi" (informal tu imperative), and "Qiskit in classe - informatica" / "- meccanica quantistica".

Both rewritten link titles are faithful and natural: "Qiskit in classe - informatica" and "Qiskit in classe - meccanica quantistica" use the standard Italian names for these fields, keep "Qiskit" in English, and leave the URLs untouched.

The meaning is faithful all the way through, including the last 40%. Variational-bound claims, the M_J/product-stage argument, the first-order vs exact angle reasoning and the qubit-excitation support claim all match the English. The problems are consistency and polish. Several terms switch form partway through the file: "Passo 2/Passo 1" becomes "Step 2/Step 1" (entries 143, 158, 164, 173, 183), "solver" becomes "solutore" (110/119/120 vs 128 onward), "pooled SQD" becomes "SQD pooled", "shell" is masculine ("lo shell") in some places and feminine ("la shell") in others, and the Setup link reads "Configurazione" in one place and "Setup" in another. There are also a typo, "iElementi" (164), a gender error, "delle semi-registri" (28), and "Ties" rendered as "I casi di parità" (62). The last one is ambiguous because "parità" means parity everywhere else on this page.

editor_note: The meaning is faithful throughout. The subtle parts all come through correctly: the qDRIFT L1-norm point (the error depends on λ, not N), the caveat in [58] that diagonal-term filtering changes the evolved operator, and the advice to skip pruning in [91]. The issues are minor. The workflow step headings are inconsistent: "Step 1/2" with infinitives ("Mappare", "Ottimizzare") becomes "Passaggio 3/4" with imperatives ("esegui"), and [69] says "Passaggio 1" while the heading says "Step 1". "Transpile" is rendered with the clunky periphrasis "trasformare con il Transpiler" in [71] and [77], where "transpilare" is already used elsewhere ("transpilazione" in [66] and [76]). "Converged SCF orbitals" became "orbitali SCF convergenti" ("converging"), which should be "a convergenza".

examples.source: Step 3: Execute using Qiskit primitives
examples.translation: Passaggio 3: esegui usando le primitive di Qiskit
examples.suggested: Passaggio 3: Eseguire usando le primitive di Qiskit (and align Step 1/2 headings to "Passaggio 1/2")
examples.why: Steps 1-2 use "Step" + infinitive while Steps 3-4 use "Passaggio" + imperative; [69] refers back to "Passaggio 1", which does not match the heading.

examples.translation: un circuito finale ottimizzato che possiamo trasformare con il Transpiler per eseguirlo sul nostro hardware
examples.suggested: un circuito finale ottimizzato che possiamo transpilare per eseguirlo sul nostro hardware
examples.why: This periphrasis is stiff, and the same file uses "transpilazione" elsewhere. The same problem appears in [77].

examples.suggested: Poiché gli integrali dipendono dagli orbitali SCF a convergenza

editor_note: Entry 18 keeps the English meaning, including the safety caveat ("Finché non lo fai, la cella non salva nulla, quindi eseguire tutte le celle non può mai sovrascrivere un account che hai salvato in precedenza"), the step 4/5 references and the informal "tu" register.

Both rewritten entries are faithful and read naturally. Entry 38 uses the correct term "modello di Ising a campo trasverso" and starts with the infinitive "Simulare", as entry 29 does. Entry 37 keeps "Shadow tomography" in English, which fits how the page already keeps titles like "Wire cutting" and "Quantum kernel training".

None of the 60 rewritten entries misleads a learner. The physics claims hold, including the -40.472331 MeV lower limit, the per-step-only reprocessing of saved samples and the discard-vs-repair contrast, and the full comparison table in [220] is present. Six terminology and wording problems remain. Transpile is rendered three ways: "Esegui la transpilation" [191], "traspila" [213] and "Traspilazione" [220]. "Pooled" appears as untranslated "pooled" [5], "raggruppati" [193] and "Unificata/unificato" [209, 220], and "mixing" [172, 189] switches to "mescolamento" [220]. Entry [195] uses the non-word "ricoupla", although [186] already has "ri-accoppiamento". In [226], "a few percent" became "alcuni punti percentuali" (percentage points). In [221], the "also" of "can also limit" was dropped.

editor_note: All three rewritten entries (18, 65, 71) keep the English meaning. Entry 65 reads naturally ("pass di transpilazione", "box annotati", "anti-rumore"). Entry 71 calques "as a result of how" as "come risultato del modo in cui", which hides the causal link; "a causa del modo in cui" or "per via di come" is what an Italian technical writer would use. Entry 18 drops the article in "pur mantenendo facilità d'uso", which should be "pur mantenendo la facilità d'uso". Neither slip would mislead a learner.

examples.source: as a result of how qubit order is captured when boxing circuits and finding unique instructions
examples.translation: come risultato del modo in cui l'ordine dei qubit viene catturato quando si boxano i circuiti e si trovano le istruzioni uniche
examples.suggested: a causa del modo in cui l'ordine dei qubit viene registrato quando si inseriscono i circuiti nei box e si individuano le istruzioni uniche
examples.why: 'Come risultato del modo' is a word-for-word calque that blurs the causal meaning; 'a causa di' says it directly.

examples.source: while retaining ease of use
examples.translation: pur mantenendo facilità d'uso
examples.suggested: pur mantenendo la facilità d'uso
examples.why: Italian needs the definite article here; without it the phrase reads as a translation.

editor_note: The rewritten entry 126 is faithful and natural. "basi di misura di Pauli" and "forma canonica attesa dall'`Executor`" keep the meaning, "basi di misura" matches the heading in entry 124, and "visita la documentazione di Samplomatic" uses the informal tu register.

The meaning is faithful throughout. I checked the caveats that matter most and none of them drift: the QAOA-vs-uniform-random comparison in [21] and [55], the brute-force admission in [43] and the score-against-full-objectives point in [49]. There is one grammar slip in the QAP note [50]: "Mantenere i accoppiamenti" should be "Mantenere gli accoppiamenti". [38] says "trasformato dal Transpiler", which adds a capitalized tool name the source does not have; "viene transpilato" is more natural there. [46] says both "circa" and "≈", so the approximation is stated twice.

editor_note: The meaning is faithful throughout. I found no semantic drift, and the scaling claims ($3^k$ vs $4^k$, logarithmic in M, independent of N), the postselection logic and the caveats all hold. The problems are polish. [82] has a broken construction, "li esegue il transpile". Some terms switch within the file: "codici spazio-temporali" in [8]/[12]/[53] becomes "codici spacetime" in [76]; "il primitive Sampler" in [63]/[64] becomes "la primitiva Sampler" in [82]; "Passaggio 1–4" in the headings becomes "Passi 1-4" and "Il passo 1" in [78]–[83]. [67] and [75] go back to English ("shadow estimator", "median-of-means", "local Pauli shadow tomography") even though "mediana delle medie" and "shadow tomography di Pauli locale" are used elsewhere.

examples.suggested: costruisce i circuiti shadow (...), ne esegue il transpile verso i gate nativi dell'hardware e li invia al primitive Sampler
examples.why: 'li esegue il transpile' is ungrammatical (it needs 'ne esegue il transpile' or 'li transpila'). It also switches to the feminine 'primitiva' after 'il primitive Sampler' in [63]/[64].

editor_note: The rewritten entries are faithful and would not mislead a learner. The numbers (1137 of 10000 shots, 49 of 120 α-determinants, 0.1373 Ha), the postselection-vs-recovery contrast and the caveat that the comparison "non è controllato" all survive intact. What remains is terminology inconsistency. The new entries use masculine "l'Hamiltoniano" (20, 120, 122, 146, 165, 176), but the rest of the page uses feminine "la Hamiltoniana". Step labels are split between "Passo" (119, 137, 141) and "Passaggio" (133, and in body text 75, 134, 139), and heading 133 alone uses a lowercase imperative. Transpile is written "traspilazione/traspila" (134, 138, 164) and "transpilazione" (71). A transpiler pass is "pass" in 71 but "passaggi"/"passaggio" in 20 and 129.

editor_note: The meaning is faithful throughout, including the trade-off argument in [63], [64] and [67] (Trotter error against two-qubit gate noise, and the δt=0.125 point agreeing worse than δt=0.25), so nothing would mislead a learner. There are two small things to fix. In [5], "eseguire la transpilazione e l'esecuzione di circuiti" is stiff and repeats "eseguire/esecuzione". "Post-processing" is kept in English in [6], [13] and [29], but the Step 4 heading [55] uses "Post-elaborare". Core terms are correct and used consistently: valori di aspettazione, transpilare, passo di Trotter, magnetizzazione staggered, and informal "tu".

examples.translation: Scopri come eseguire la transpilazione e l'esecuzione di circuiti quantistici sull'hardware usando Julia
examples.suggested: Scopri come transpilare ed eseguire circuiti quantistici sull'hardware usando Julia
examples.why: Turning both verbs into nouns gives a stiff 'eseguire ... l'esecuzione' repetition. A native writer would just use the two verbs.

examples.suggested: Passo 4: Eseguire il post-processing e restituire il risultato nel formato classico desiderato
examples.why: The rest of the file keeps 'post-processing' in English ([6], [13], [29]). This heading switches to 'post-elaborare', so the term is inconsistent within the page.
